hero.tag: 30 days, 90 meals, halal and high protein. Carbs follow your workouts, with keto and fasting days when you want them.

numbers.title: Built around your body and your training.
numbers.lede: Protein stays high every day to protect muscle while you lose fat. Calories and carbs move with your workouts.
facts: water a day, plus electrolytes on keto days
fiber from vegetables, berries, chia and flax
a day, with protein at every one

week.title: Carbs follow your workouts.
week.lede: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday are training days. The rest of the week is built to burn fat, and two of those days are true keto days.

steps.title: Training days
steps.body: Carbs rise to about 95 g, never above 100, so the lifts and the plyo work stay strong. Rice, sweet potato, oats or fruit sit around the workout.

steps.title: Low-carb days
steps.body: About 46 g of carbs: lean protein, vegetables and healthy fats. Fasting 16:8 is optional on these days.

steps.title: Keto days
steps.body: Net carbs 20 g or less and fat-forward meals: avocado, olive oil, salmon, ribeye, lamb. Built on a 16:8 window from noon to 8 PM.

clock.title: Fasting, only when you choose it.
clock.lede: Pick a day type to see where the eating window sits. Keto days are built on 16:8. Low-carb days can use it. Training days keep the full window so you can fuel and recover.

notes.HIGH: Eat protein within two hours after training. If you train fasted, make that meal the biggest of the day.
notes.LOW: Same three meals, same totals. Move them to noon, 3:30 and 7:30 for 16:8 whenever you feel like fasting.
notes.KETO: Meals at 12:00, 3:30 and 7:30 PM. Water, black coffee and plain tea until noon. Prefer to eat early? The same food works at 8:00, 12:30 and 6:30.

altNote.LOW: 16:8 on a low-carb day: first bite at noon, last by 8 PM. Water, black coffee and tea before then.

dishes.title: {dishes} dishes you will actually cook.
dishes.lede: Swipe through the plan. Tap a dish to see exactly what goes in it and which days it lands on.

days.title: Your 30 days.
days.lede: Every day, every meal, every macro. Tap a day to open it.

shop.title: Shopping, week by week.
shop.lede: Tick things off as they go in the basket. Your ticks stay on this device.

swap.title: Swap like for like.
swap.lede: Pick a food and see the three closest swaps in the same group, with the macro difference.

track.title: Track your weight.
track.lede: Log it once a week, same morning. The chart shows you against the plan line, and the two-week trend tells you more than any single day.

rules.title: Your food rules.
eat: Halal lean protein: chicken, turkey, lean beef, lamb, white fish, salmon, shrimp, tuna
Eggs and egg whites, plain Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, halal-certified whey
Spinach, peppers, zucchini, mushrooms, tomatoes, cucumber, green beans, asparagus, broccoli, cauliflower
Olive oil, avocado, almonds, walnuts, chia, flax, tahini, pumpkin seeds
Training days only: basmati or brown rice, sweet potato, oats, quinoa, pita, fruit
limit: Carbs: training days never above 100 g, low-carb days about 45 g, keto days 20 g net or less
Whole eggs: 3 a day at most
Whey: 2 scoops a day at most, only to top up protein
Oils, nuts and seeds are measured, since fat is 9 kcal a gram
Shrimp is accepted by most, not all, halal schools. Swap for fish if you prefer
avoid: Pork, bacon, ham, lard and pork gelatin
Alcohol, including wine in cooking and alcohol-based vanilla or flavor extracts
Meat that is not halal-certified or zabiha
Gelatin or enzymes of unknown origin in yogurt, whey, broth or sauces
Sugary drinks, juice, desserts and ultra-processed snacks
rules.note: No pork or pork-derived ingredient appears in any meal, recipe or swap. Buy halal-certified meat and whey, and read labels on yogurt, broth and sauces.

HIGH.label: Training day
HIGH.daynote: Carbs fuel the session. Eat protein within two hours after you train.

LOW.label: Low-carb day
LOW.daynote: Lean protein, vegetables and healthy fats. Optional 16:8.

KETO.label: Keto day
KETO.daynote: Net carbs 20 g or less, on the 16:8 window (12 to 8 PM). Salt your food and drink your water.
